old: The API is no longer self-serve: 'The API is currently in limited release; contact our team to request access', on the Expression Measurement overview. The pricing URL no longer exists as a page: https://www.hume.ai/pricing and https://platform.hume.ai/pricing both land on the marketing home page, which now sells a voice-AI evaluation platform rather than an API. Third-party readings of the pricing page from September 2026 recorded a Free plan at '10,000 characters per month, 5 EVI minutes, 15 requests per minute, 1 concurrent connection' plus USD 20 of new-account credits.
new: The API is not self-serve: on the Expression Measurement API launch the vendor states 'The Expression Measurement API is now available in limited release' and 'Contact our team to request access, then start with the overview'.
